title: CodeReel: Accelerating Code-to-Video Agents with Exact Frame Reuse and Blocking-Aware Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2611.22967v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents make videos by writing and refining programs in a build--inspect--edit loop. A finished film costs a median of $2.85 in model calls and 11 minutes, over a third of that time in builds that block the agent. We find that much of this time is avoidable, for two reasons. First, 37.5% of the frames of a session's later films were drawn before, many shifted in time or inside an edited scene. Second, half of the builds stop at a check, where the agent needs only the verdict, but which builds stop is unknown until the checks finish. We present CodeReel, a training-free execution layer behind agents' existing commands. Exact frame reuse keys each frame by its drawing commands, regardless of its position in time, and reuses each frame whose key recurs. Blocking-aware scheduling runs the checks first and starts the render alongside them, at idle priority, unless the session's recent builds make a pass unlikely. Scheduling spends CPU

translated_title: CodeReel：通过精确帧复用与阻塞感知调度加速代码生成视频智能体
translated_abstract: 编程智能体通过在“构建—检查—编辑”循环中编写和完善程序来制作视频。一部完成的影片平均需要2.85美元的模型调用费用和11分钟，其中超过三分之一的时间耗费在阻塞智能体的构建上。我们发现其中大量时间是可以避免的，原因有二：第一，在会话后期影片的帧中，有37.5%的帧此前已被绘制过，其中许多只是在时间上有所偏移或位于被编辑过的场景内；第二，一半的构建会在某个检查点停止，此时智能体只需要检查结果，但哪些构建会停止在检查完成之前是无法得知的。我们提出了CodeReel，这是一个无需训练的执行层，运行在智能体现有命令的背后。精确帧复用通过每帧的绘制命令为其建立键值（与其在时间轴上的位置无关），并复用任何键值再次出现的帧。阻塞感知调度优先运行检查任务，并同时以空闲优先级启动渲染，除非会话近期的构建情况表明检查不太可能通过。调度利用CPU……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: CodeReel无需训练，通过按绘制命令精确复用已绘制的帧，并采用优先运行检查、以空闲优先级并行启动渲染的阻塞感知调度，大幅削减代码生成视频智能体中因构建阻塞而浪费的时间。
en_tdlr: CodeReel is a training-free execution layer that accelerates code-to-video agents by exactly reusing frames keyed to their drawing commands and using blocking-aware scheduling that runs checks first while rendering in parallel at idle priority.
